'''Defense Minister''' was a title on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Blaine Harris]] was Defense Minister during the [[Ssi-ruu]] [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|invasion]] of the planet.
